Hot Seat's real name was Michael A. Taylor and he was born in Bath, Avon, United Kingdom. He was part of a G.I. Joe team in the Latin American county of Sao Cristobel who prevented Cobra from securing a nuclear warhead.

page.overview:
Who is Hot Seat?

Hot Seat's real name was Michael A. Taylor and he was born in Bath, Avon, United Kingdom. He was part of a G.I. Joe team in the Latin American county of Sao Cristobel who prevented Cobra from securing a nuclear warhead.

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

The only Hot Seat figure ever was available packaged with the Raider jet vehicle in the 1989 series of Real American Hero toys. ---- Appearance: grey hair; beige shirt with green vest; orange pants; black gloves, belt and boots

Accessories: black helmet covering one eye and with attached mic. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/89/hotseat.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/89/hotseat.shtml Filecard]
